cd /workspace && cat > tests/plan_scale.py <<'PYEOF'
import sys, time, resource
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/deps')
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tests')
from plan_perf import build
from common import validate
from planning import solve
for nreq, noff, pairs in ((100,200,1000),(200,400,3000),(400,800,10000),(800,1600,30000),(1600,3200,100000)):
    job = build(nreq=nreq, noff=noff, pairs=pairs, seed=5)
    ctx = validate(job)
    active = {r['id']: True for r in job['requests']}
    t=time.time(); plan=solve(ctx, active); dt=time.time()-t
    print('nreq=%d noff=%d pairs=%d -> resolved=%d cost=%d  %.2fs  maxrss=%.0fMB' % (
        nreq, noff, pairs, plan['resolved'], plan['cost'], dt, resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss/1024))
PYEOF
timeout 600 python3 tests/plan_scale.py
